initial_invalid_attempt.reason: The worker independently created a second worktree and committed there; the assigned worktree stayed at the base commit.

controlled_pair.first_action: cherry-pick the test artifact commit into the assigned worktree
controlled_pair.second_action: read-only verify assigned worktree, branch, HEAD, artifact and clean status

conclusion: The successful pair proves committed code survives release and is visible to a distinct supervised step in the exact same Orca worktree. The first invalid attempt shows that Orca settlement alone does not guarantee the agent used the assigned worktree; the center must compare reported and observed workspace identity before advancing.
